meta.scope: Full local audit, audit-only, no production accounts or external secrets
notes: Findings marked fixed are revalidated old findings, not active bugs.
Supabase pgTAP was attempted but blocked because local Supabase/Postgres was not running on 127.0.0.1:54322.
Account browser checks used local test env values and did not authenticate a real user.

command_results.summary: Fails in apps/marketing app/components/landing/Hero.tsx:144 with react-hooks/set-state-in-effect.
Recursive test gate fails at extension/tests/transport-contracts.test.ts because event/auth-transition is present in protocols but missing from expected constants.
All workspace typecheck targets completed successfully.
Build succeeds; SSG emits repeated Node --localstorage-file warnings.
Fails without env stubs while collecting /api/v1/plans page data: missing NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL, NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY, TRAIL_EXTENSION_JWT_SECRET, DATABASE_URL.
Typecheck, lint, and format pass; ESLint reports 3 warnings.
Fails at transport-contracts.test.ts due AUTH_TRANSITION contract drift.
Production build succeeds; warns about unresolved font file references, dynamic/static import overlap, and chunks over 500 kB.
5 tests ran: 2 passed, 3 failed on stale onboarding/settings expected UI text.

command_results.command: pnpm -C apps/account test -- targeted account API/security tests
command_results.summary: 148 tests passed, 8 failed, 1 suite failed. Failures include missing Supabase env in tests, NOWPayments db.from mock mismatch, and unsupported grant type expected code drift.
11 tests passed; expected test stderr logs Telegram API error for failure-path test.
Blocked locally: failed to connect to 127.0.0.1:54322, connection refused.
10 production vulnerabilities: 2 high, 7 moderate, 1 low. Includes Next.js DoS and Picomatch ReDoS.

Marketing pages load. Account pages redirect to login when unauthenticated but emit next-intl INVALID_KEY errors for dotted message keys. Extension preview server reports unresolved imports for RenameNodeDialog and #i18n modules.

findings.title: Public billing/subscription APIs accept unsigned internal:<uuid> bearer tokens
findings.impact: Any caller that knows or guesses a user UUID can ask public billing/subscription routes to resolve that user without a signed extension token or cookie session. The code comment says this token is for in-process proxy routes, but the public route handlers opt into it directly.
evidence: apps/account/src/server/auth/get-authenticated-user.ts:56-59 resolves internal:<uuid> when allowInternal is true.
apps/account/app/api/v1/subscription/route.ts:21-22 and apps/account/app/api/v1/billing/route.ts:24-25 pass allowInternal: true on public Request handlers.
rg found allowInternal usage across billing, portal, subscription, checkout, cancel, and resume API routes.
findings.repro: Send Authorization: Bearer internal:<victim-user-uuid> to a route that passes allowInternal after local DB has a matching user row.

findings.title: Server ensurePublicUser still hardcodes email_verified=true and does not call the sync RPC
findings.impact: Migration 013 explicitly added sync_public_user_from_auth to keep public.users aligned with auth.users, but the account server path still writes optimistic email_verified=true and ignores duplicates. Email verification state can drift depending on which surface provisions the row.
evidence: apps/account/src/server/backend/user.ts:83-95 upserts email_verified: true with ignoreDuplicates.
supabase/migrations/013_email_verified_source_of_truth.sql:12-16 says server code should call sync_public_user_from_auth and replace this drift.
extension/src/shared/auth/auth-orchestrator.ts:204-206 does call the RPC, so behavior differs by surface.
findings.repro: Create or refresh a web account path where public.users exists or email verification changes; compare public.users.email_verified to auth.users.email_confirmed_at.

findings.title: Global extension-session revoke still uses read-modify-write instead of atomic auth_session_version RPC
findings.impact: Concurrent revocations can lose an auth_session_version increment, leaving some access tokens valid longer than intended. Migration 013 added bump_auth_session_version specifically to replace this pattern.
evidence: apps/account/src/server/backend/oauth.ts:505-523 reads auth_session_version then updates it with current + 1.
supabase/migrations/013_email_verified_source_of_truth.sql:50-68 defines bump_auth_session_version and documents the race.
findings.repro: Run concurrent revokeAllExtensionSessionsForUser calls and observe whether version increments once or twice.

findings.title: Account deletion fallback still soft-deletes every accessible trail when RPC fails
findings.impact: If request_account_deletion fails, the extension falls back to updating trails where id != all-zero UUID. Today RLS scopes damage to the caller, but any RLS regression turns this into a cross-tenant wipe, and even the scoped behavior deletes all of the user's trails on an RPC failure.
evidence: extension/src/apps/settings/pages/AccountPage.tsx:440-445 runs supabase.from('trails').update(...).neq('id', all-zero) when rpcResult.error is present.
This was a P0 in the 2026-04-19 review and remains present.
findings.repro: Force request_account_deletion RPC to fail and observe fallback update over trails with only neq('id', zero) as a predicate.

findings.title: Single-trail upsert remains read-then-write without a transaction
findings.impact: Concurrent sync requests for the same trail can both observe no existing row or stale metadata, causing unique conflicts or last-write surprises outside a transaction.
evidence: apps/account/src/server/backend/trails-sync.ts:345-352 reads the existing row.
apps/account/src/server/backend/trails-sync.ts:400-426 then separately updates or inserts.
findings.repro: Fire concurrent PUT/upsert requests for the same trail id and device/user under the same timestamp window.

findings.title: ensureSyncDevices still reassigns existing device ids across users
findings.impact: If the same device id appears under a different account, the server updates the device owner instead of rejecting or namespacing it. This can break trails that reference the previous owner's device id.
evidence: apps/account/src/server/backend/trails-sync.ts:162-170 logs device ownership reassignment and then updates the device.
findings.repro: Sync two accounts with the same persisted device id and inspect devices.user_id before and after the second sync.

findings.title: Extension aggregate test gate is red from AUTH_TRANSITION protocol contract drift
findings.impact: The primary extension test script stops at transport-contracts.test.ts, hiding later tests in the chained script and blocking CI.
evidence: pnpm test and pnpm -C extension test both fail with actual EXTENSION_MESSAGE containing event/auth-transition while expected list does not.
extension/src/shared/transport/protocols.ts:21 declares AUTH_TRANSITION; extension/tests/transport-contracts.test.ts:47 expected list omits it.
findings.repro: Run pnpm -C extension test.

findings.title: Extension Playwright e2e suite is stale: 3 of 5 tests fail
findings.impact: Release-relevant browser automation does not reflect the current onboarding/settings UI, so e2e cannot be trusted as a shipping gate.
evidence: pnpm -C extension exec playwright test: onboarding heading 'Welcome to Trail' not found.
Privacy onboarding heading 'What Trail records' not found.
Settings heading 'Trail Settings' not found.
2 tests pass, 3 fail.
findings.repro: Run pnpm -C extension build && pnpm -C extension exec playwright test.

findings.title: Manual smoke/ui stubs still pass with assert.ok(true)
findings.impact: The extension test script presents critical auth/offline/export/UI scenarios as executable tests, but they only log manual instructions and always pass.
evidence: extension/tests/smoke-e2e.test.ts:4-8 documents always-passing stubs.
extension/tests/ui-interaction.test.ts:4-8 documents always-passing stubs.
rg found 17 occurrences of 'stub - automation pending' across these files.
findings.repro: Inspect smoke-e2e.test.ts and ui-interaction.test.ts; each scenario ends with assert.ok(true).

findings.title: Targeted account API tests are red from env, mock, and response-code drift
findings.impact: The account API suite currently mixes real failures and harness failures, which makes auth/billing regression review unreliable.
evidence: Targeted account test run: 148 passed, 8 failed, 1 suite failed.
trails.test.ts fails at import because NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL and NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY are missing.
nowpayments-webhook.test.ts fails because route uses db.from but mock does not provide it.
oauth.test.ts unsupported grant type expected unsupported_grant_type but route returns VALIDATION_ERROR.
findings.repro: Run the targeted account test command recorded in command_results.
commands: pnpm -C apps/account test -- src/lib/__tests__/auth.test.ts app/api/v1/__tests__/billing.test.ts app/api/v1/__tests__/subscription.test.ts app/api/v1/__tests__/nowpayments-webhook.test.ts app/api/v1/__tests__/oauth.test.ts app/api/v1/__tests__/trails-sync.test.ts

findings.title: Neon preview workflow calls missing root script db:migrate:deploy
findings.impact: PR database preview/migration validation likely fails before schema diff, because the workflow invokes a script absent from package.json.
evidence: .github/workflows/neon-workflow.yml:67-68 runs pnpm db:migrate:deploy.
Root package.json scripts include db:migrate and db:types, but not db:migrate:deploy.
findings.repro: Run rg -n 'db:migrate:deploy' .github/workflows package.json.

findings.title: Extension workflows cache against missing extension/pnpm-lock.yaml
findings.impact: CI, release, and security audit workflows reference a lockfile that does not exist, while root pnpm-lock.yaml changes do affect extension installs. This causes cache drift and path-trigger blind spots.
evidence: test -f extension/pnpm-lock.yaml returned missing.
.github/workflows/ci-extension.yml:36, release-extension.yml:42, and security.yml:46 use cache-dependency-path: extension/pnpm-lock.yaml.
git ls-files shows root and nested app/package lockfiles but no extension lockfile.
findings.repro: Run test -f extension/pnpm-lock.yaml and inspect workflow cache-dependency-path entries.
commands: test -f extension/pnpm-lock.yaml && echo exists || echo missing

findings.title: Extension release gate is weaker than extension CI
findings.impact: The tag release workflow can package and upload a draft extension without running the same format and Playwright e2e gates used by CI.
evidence: ci-extension.yml runs Format check and E2E Playwright.
release-extension.yml runs lint, typecheck, test, build, package, upload, but not format:check or Playwright e2e.
findings.repro: Compare .github/workflows/ci-extension.yml and release-extension.yml.

findings.title: Supabase pgTAP path is locally blocked and CI uses unpinned CLI plus missing seed file
findings.impact: Database-policy verification is not reproducible locally without starting Supabase, and CI can drift with latest CLI behavior. config.toml enables seed.sql but the file is absent.
evidence: pnpm exec supabase test db failed locally: connection refused on 127.0.0.1:54322.
ci-supabase.yml:20-23 uses supabase/setup-cli version: latest.
supabase/config.toml:60-65 enables ./seed.sql; test -f supabase/seed.sql returned missing.
findings.repro: Run pnpm exec supabase test db without local Supabase running; inspect ci-supabase.yml and supabase/config.toml.
commands: test -f supabase/seed.sql && echo present || echo missing

findings.title: Production dependency audit reports 10 vulnerabilities including high Next.js and Picomatch advisories
findings.impact: The app ships with vulnerable versions according to pnpm audit. The highest impact item is Next.js Server Components DoS, patched in >=16.2.3; current Next.js is 16.1.6.
evidence: pnpm audit --prod found 10 vulnerabilities: 2 high, 7 moderate, 1 low.
High advisories: Picomatch ReDoS and Next.js DoS with Server Components.
Moderate advisories include Next.js request smuggling, image cache growth, postponed resume buffering, Server Actions CSRF, follow-redirects header leak, and PostCSS XSS.
findings.repro: Run pnpm audit --prod.

findings.title: Workspace lint fails on marketing Hero useEffect setState
findings.impact: The top-level lint gate is red, so CI should block and any later lint findings are masked until this is fixed.
evidence: pnpm lint fails at apps/marketing/app/components/landing/Hero.tsx:144.
ESLint rule react-hooks/set-state-in-effect rejects synchronous setEnableVideo(false) inside useEffect.
findings.repro: Run pnpm lint.

findings.title: Account build fails locally without CI env stubs
findings.impact: The documented local build command is not self-contained; /api/v1/plans imports server env during page-data collection and fails before build completion.
evidence: pnpm -C apps/account build fails: missing NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL, NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY, TRAIL_EXTENSION_JWT_SECRET, DATABASE_URL.
ci-web.yml works around this with env stubs, but README quickstart still mentions stale Prisma scripts instead of these env requirements.
findings.repro: Run pnpm -C apps/account build in a clean shell without app env files.

findings.title: Account app emits next-intl INVALID_KEY errors from dotted message keys
findings.impact: Every account route inspected logs a runtime i18n error because keys under the errors namespace contain dots. This can break translated error rendering and pollutes browser console during normal navigation.
evidence: Browser checks on /login, /onboarding, /trails, /activity, /billing, /settings showed next-intl INVALID_KEY errors.
apps/account/messages/en.json and ru.json define errors.auth.unauthorized, trail.notFound, billing.missingPlan, onboarding.resetFailed as flat dotted keys.
findings.repro: Start account dev server and open http://localhost:4001/login; inspect browser console.

findings.title: Feedback widget dialog focuses textarea but has no visible focus trap or focus restore
findings.impact: Keyboard users can likely tab behind the modal, and closing the widget may not restore focus to the trigger. This is a high-friction support path.
evidence: FeedbackWidget sets aria-modal=true and focuses textarea with setTimeout.
No focus-trap implementation or trigger focus restore is visible around the dialog open/close code.
findings.repro: Open feedback widget, tab through focusable elements, close with Escape, and check focus location.

findings.title: Account trail cards are clickable Cards instead of links/buttons, and actions are hover-hidden
findings.impact: The card navigation is not semantic for keyboard and assistive tech users, while the action menu is invisible until hover/focus. This is the primary account trail navigation surface.
evidence: trails-list.tsx:161-168 renders Card with onClick router.push.
trails-list.tsx:190-196 renders icon button hidden with opacity-0 until group hover/focus.
findings.repro: Keyboard through /trails with sample data and check whether each card is reachable and announced as a link.

findings.title: Multiple important actions are hover-only or opacity-hidden
findings.impact: Touch users and keyboard users without exact focus paths may miss open/external/rename/delete actions in account and extension tree surfaces.
evidence: apps/account/app/(dashboard)/trails/[id]/trail-detail.tsx:290 hides external link until group hover.
extension/src/apps/sidepanel/ui/components/TreeDropdown.tsx:519 hides item actions until group hover or selected state.
findings.repro: Use touch emulation or keyboard-only navigation on trail detail and extension TreeDropdown.

findings.title: Extension onboarding uses fixed-height dialog and non-modal dialog semantics for modal-like overlays
findings.impact: The wizard can clip on short sidepanel heights and celebration/commitment overlays may be announced as dialogs while allowing background interaction semantics.
evidence: OnboardingWizard DialogContent uses h-[480px] max-w-[400px].
TourCelebration uses role=dialog aria-modal=false while covering the sidepanel.
findings.repro: Open extension preview or sidepanel at short heights and run keyboard/screen-reader dialog checks through onboarding.

findings.title: Graph node fixed dimensions risk truncating long titles and URLs
findings.impact: Trail's core value is scannable research context. Fixed 160 x 60 nodes can hide meaningful title/URL distinctions in dense research sessions.
evidence: TrailNode uses min-h-[60px] w-[160px] with compact title/detail presentation.
This needs sample long-label browser verification before fixing.
findings.repro: Load preview data or a real tree with long page titles and compare visible node labels at multiple zoom levels.

findings.title: README and env comments still describe removed Prisma/Better Auth/tRPC workflows
findings.impact: New contributors and agents following README will run nonexistent scripts and build the wrong mental model of the backend stack.
evidence: README references Prisma, Better Auth, tRPC, db:generate, db:migrate:deploy, db:studio.
Root package.json does not define db:generate, db:migrate:deploy, or db:studio.
apps/account/.env.example still says DATABASE_URL is required for Prisma CLI.
findings.repro: Run rg -n 'Prisma|Better Auth|tRPC|db:migrate:deploy|db:generate' README.md apps/account/.env.example package.json.

findings.title: Extension production build passes with unresolved font references and >500 kB chunk warnings
findings.impact: The extension ships a 551 kB background chunk and 635 kB react-vendor chunk. Build also leaves several font URL references unresolved at build time.
evidence: pnpm -C extension build completed successfully.
Warnings: Geist font file references did not resolve at build time; settings.ts is dynamically and statically imported; chunks larger than 500 kB.
findings.repro: Run pnpm -C extension build.

findings.title: Extension preview:ui starts but Vite cannot resolve sidepanel imports
findings.impact: The local UI preview route is not trustworthy for sidepanel/onboarding review because Vite reports unresolved imports for a missing RenameNodeDialog component and the #i18n alias. This blocks the requested browser preview path from exercising the real extension UI.
evidence: pnpm -C extension preview:ui served on localhost:5174, then Vite logged failed import analysis for extension/preview/PreviewApp.tsx:3.
Vite also logged unresolved #i18n imports from OnboardingWizard.tsx, onboarding wizard screens, and useDeleteFlow.ts.
rg --files extension/src | rg 'Rename|rename|i18n' found inline-rename-context.tsx but no RenameNodeDialog file.
findings.repro: Run pnpm -C extension preview:ui and open the preview route; observe Vite import-analysis errors for @apps/sidepanel/ui/components/RenameNodeDialog and #i18n.

findings.title: Old P0 users RLS column-write issue appears fixed by migration 014 and pgTAP coverage
findings.impact: The old finding should not remain active unless pgTAP fails in a running Supabase environment.
evidence: supabase/migrations/014_users_column_grants.sql revokes broad update and grants a safe column allow-list.
supabase/tests/rls_users.test.sql asserts users cannot update email_verified or auth_session_version.
Local pgTAP could not run because Supabase was not started.
findings.repro: Start local Supabase and run pnpm exec supabase test db.

findings.title: Old P0 account-deletion RPC revocation gap appears fixed by migration 008 and pgTAP coverage
findings.impact: The RPC now revokes extension_device_sessions and oauth_refresh_tokens and bumps auth_session_version; local DB verification remains blocked.
evidence: supabase/migrations/008_fix_account_deletion_rpc.sql updates extension_device_sessions and oauth_refresh_tokens and bumps auth_session_version.
supabase/tests/request_account_deletion.test.sql asserts these effects.
findings.repro: Start local Supabase and run pnpm exec supabase test db.

findings.title: Old MV3 setInterval sync-pull and Supabase autoRefreshToken issue appears fixed
findings.impact: Periodic sync now uses chrome.alarms and Supabase autoRefreshToken is disabled for the extension client.
evidence: extension/src/background/sync/sync-engine.ts:85-90 documents chrome.alarms as authoritative.
sync-engine.ts:1445-1449 creates trail-sync-pull alarm.
service-worker.ts:36-43 registers onAlarm at module top level.
shared/lib/supabase.ts:39-42 sets autoRefreshToken: false.
findings.repro: Inspect listed files; runtime alarm wake behavior still deserves a browser/service-worker trace in a later fix pass.

findings.title: Old pending-op skipped-as-terminal loss appears fixed
findings.impact: Skipped push outcomes are no longer removed from the pending queue, and cold-start drain waits for the first signed-in transition.
evidence: sync-engine.ts:182-188 says skipped is not terminal.
sync-engine.ts:1512-1516 documents waiting for signed-in transition to avoid the old queue-loss bug.
findings.repro: Queue a pending push, wake the service worker signed out, then sign in and confirm the queue drains after auth settles.

findings.title: Old import-device ownership collision appears fixed
findings.impact: Import device ids are now scoped by user id, so one user's import device should not collide with another user's import device.
evidence: apps/account/app/api/v1/trails/import/route.ts:16-17 returns import:<userId>.
The old hardcoded import device id is no longer present.
findings.repro: Import trails under two users and compare devices.id values.

findings.title: Old permissive chrome-extension CORS issue appears fixed
findings.impact: CORS now allowlists explicit extension IDs instead of startsWith chrome-extension://, and omits Access-Control-Allow-Origin for disallowed origins.
evidence: apps/account/src/server/api/cors.ts parses OAUTH_ALLOWED_EXTENSION_IDS into exact origins.
corsHeaders only emits Access-Control-Allow-Origin when origin is in the allowlist.
findings.repro: Run cors tests or call OPTIONS with a random chrome-extension:// origin.

findings.title: Old packages/trpc ghost-router finding appears resolved
findings.impact: The old trpc package is gone and the remaining package is auth-token. A stray packages/ui directory only contains ignored node_modules bins.
evidence: test -d packages/trpc returned missing.
find packages -maxdepth 2 -name package.json lists auth-token, config, content, db only.
packages/ui has no package.json and only ignored node_modules bin entries.
findings.repro: Run test -d packages/trpc and find packages -maxdepth 2 -name package.json.
commands: test -d packages/trpc && echo trpc-exists || echo trpc-missing
